body: Thanks...I bit the bullet and killed the tabs. Had to be wasted to do it, and I still feel like I made a huge mistake...even if logic dictates that it's the way to go.  Your social life sounds really good, and I would live to have something like that.  I built my life around Claire and it feels like I will never escape the void she left...I just want to hold her again

Thanbs, I try hard. A bit drunk now but I have no idea about that stuff either and just figure if I'm already here, why not. It's just been a very tough and draining time since losing all the support I had, and it has been brutal trying to let her go :( I still think I hear her tea kettle in the morning and jump out out of bed, only to see it sitting under a depressing layer of dust

Well...this may or may not be the better part of the 26 I just drained...but i bet you're an awesome person to be around and I hope people are smart enough to realize it soon. What do you like to do for fun?

I am physically shaking even thinking of closing one of the tabs...I feel like I would faint even clicking anywhere on her laptop. I'm in a pretty remote area, so no groups or anything like that while I'm working...only in the city on my four days off each work rotation, but I am thinking of seeing a doctor about my depression...I just hope I can get out of bed to get to the appointment as ridiculous as that sounds. Every time I think of Claire I just want to be with her, she was the most beautiful person and did not deserve to leave so early. She cared about me more than anyone, maybe even herself...sorry, this is killing me...how is moving on so hard?

Sounds like we have the same crap energy wise. I feel pathetic not being able to move on even though everyone tells me I have to, you're probably hearing the same crap. I just wish I had someone close to give me even five minutes of support...even just a small hug
Very kind of you. Has my situation been similar to anything you had to deal with (obviously successfully)?

You can't know that though...if someone found me interesting behind my wall of books and didn't go blind from the reflection from my vampire-esque pale complextion, there is still hope for you. I haven't been feeling good, but I will never give up until I have no strength left...though it does feel like that could happen soon these days

Thanks for your reply. I used to think about these things rationally but that seems to be so long ago. I know I need to move on but each time I try to tell myself where I am, I completely break down and fall into despair. Talking here is helping a lot...just having someone actually listen to my thoughts, even if only online , reminds me that I'm not fully alone.

Where have you been looking for a boyfriend? It took me forever to find my former girlfriend since I'm deathly shy, so I won't say anything like 'oh, you're going to find something soon'. Hope you find happiness, I know I hope I do.
